Telangana CM Pays Tribute on Jaipal Reddy's Death Anniversary

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy paid tribute to former Union Minister S. Jaipal Reddy on his death anniversary. The event marked the remembrance of Jaipal Reddy's contributions. The Chief Minister honored his legacy on this occasion.
